| `packages/control/atlas.mjs`（v4でthin bootstrapへ縮小） | apps側のapplication source選択・query/EventSource/実clock/timer・SharedUIのwiring候補 |
| application固有の意味/state/観測sourceから `ui.liveAtlasInput.v1` への変換 | owning domain / apps側のInputAdapter。actual source/distribution/consumerを本Issueの認識合わせでinventoryしてからpathと最小実装を固定 |
| application固有のhost/deployment/config | apps側の実consumer/deployment接続。本Issue作成やUI例示だけでは実装を開始しない |

`packages/control/atlas-ui.mjs`、`src/live-atlas.mjs`、`src/live-atlas-projection.mjs` はSharedUIとしてUIに残す。UI-input validation/currentness/history/appearanceをbusiness authorityへ読み替えない。UIのbuilder/fixture/Node/browser証明もUI側に保持し、apps側には必要なconsumer integration証明を設ける。具体的な公開import/export/配布/組立methodは、移行前のactual inventoryと独立GOで固定する。

## UIに残すもの・依存方向

```text
meaning/state owner (例 adrs)
            ↓ projected input
apps/atlas  # application・domain入力変換・lens/操作フロー
            ↓ consumes
ui
  control/atlas-ui.mjs                # shared Atlas screen/HTML+SVG interaction
  control/src/live-atlas.mjs          # UI input read-model/history/currentness
  control/src/live-atlas-projection.mjs # UI layout/status/LOD/scene
  semantic-map/camera-fit.js          # 単一UI-owned fit math
  semantic-map renderer/maxGraph     # scene/SVG + generic interaction
  semantic-map protocol/projection   # generic view/scene/LOD capability
  a2ui-browser                       # DOM host/catalog/native SVG island
  data-pin + control input contracts # existing read-only UI input contract
  browser-module-closure helper       # generic assembly helper
  build-live-atlas / shared UI tests  # UI assembly/closure/quality proofを保持
  owner-correct minimal proofs        # application意味を再導入しない
  examples/atlas                       # exact JSONL -> Graph/Seq HTML witness; UIに残す
```

camera-fitは `(World, Viewport, margin=0.98) → frozen Camera` のUI責務。appsへ移さない。camera state/apply/eventとprojection/LODは別責務。
既存control入力parserをdomain権限と解釈しない。active/inactiveは構造状態、heartbeatはWorkの証拠ではない。意味・判断・state authorityはowning domainのまま。UI→apps/Atlasへの逆依存を作らない。

## 移行の検証・完了条件

- [ ] adopted UI source/head/treeと利用package/interfaceを固定。上記GREENの入力との一致を確認。
- [ ] application input/wiringの各owner・実consumer・公開UI import/export・Nix/CI/build/fixture入口をinventoryし、必要なcode/import接続だけを小さく固定。
- [ ] apps AtlasがUI-owned fit/renderer/contractsをconsumeし、単一実装ownerを維持。意味/state authorityの逆流なし。
- [ ] #328 input-preservationと#327 surface責務の既存保証を保持。
- [ ] UIの `examples/atlas` / input / semantic-map reproducibility proofをapplicationと一緒に移さず、UI側でGraph/Seq witnessが存続する。Atlas applicationをconsumerから外しても、この既存UI module closureにappsへの逆依存を追加しない。
- [ ] application Node checks：mandatory topology fail-closed、optional channel isolation、stale/duplicate、logical actor、parallel work、4参照、history/gap/auditを保持。
- [ ] 移行したexact consumer/composed treeでUI-owned Live Atlas acceptance（v4 app+example **80checks**）と必要なapps integrationを実行：offline file://、300 scopes/depth4、1280×800/1440×900、LOD、budget、label geometry、selection、reduced motion、served EventSource UNKNOWN/recovery。
- [ ] standalone ESM closure / input-output receipt / notice-license / no external executable sourceを保持。移行後のregistry/package identityが変わるならcanonical生成/check。
- [ ] 実User入口でHTML search/Inspector、SVG selection/zoom/pan/Fit、接続断UNKNOWN→新accepted revision復帰、selection/geometry保持を確認。
- [ ] source/test/rendererの二重実装・stale import・旧ui application bootstrapの残件0を独立確認し、SharedUIとUI-owned witness/testを撤去しない。

UI#331で検証した新生成物は **2,251,158 bytes / 150 modules / sha256 `40bad824f92967b569f39a9cc52a3491170a683d7044b2380abe204bf3653685`**。移行でbuild入力/pathが変わるので、このhashや旧runを新treeのPASSへ改名せず、移行した実体で比較・再検証する。

## 境界

このIssueはownership移行。新renderer/万能camera framework/registry/planner、A2UIとmaxGraphの統合、semantic-mapの別Fit policyとの統合、domain authority移管は含めない。
OCI全agent・全Projectの実観測や旧Atlasのpurpose/lens改善は、必要な実producer/domain契約を別に固定する後続仕事。現在のfixture/SSE proofを実収集完了として扱わない。

merge/Issue close/外部公開/最終採用はR/W技術GREENと別。実装前にこのIssueの担当・scope・必要な許可・閉包したcheck/fix/independent gateを認識合わせする。

ui#322の追加Phase 4要件に対し、[ui#332](https://github.com/roccho-dev/ui/pull/332)のP/R/W3 v2合意 → fix/check → [R最終GREEN](https://github.com/roccho-dev/ui/pull/332#issuecomment-6010902029)が成立。技術残件0。head `e4a188bddc3ffa2905162110cd47e820c096e470`、合成candidate tree `125188026116acdd104b3e7c98d0663ed74b5849`。[W3最終source/CI](https://github.com/roccho-dev/ui/pull/332#issuecomment-6010840531)、[P最終headの実証](https://github.com/roccho-dev/ui/pull/332#issuecomment-6010853287)。

Humanの定義は `examples = ui capability = for application usecase`。#332 v2のGraph/Seq GREENは有効な部分証明として残すが、Atlas app相当の画面・操作を同じ再利用UIで合成できる完成判定へ流用しない。

[ui#332 P v3議題](https://github.com/roccho-dev/ui/pull/332#issuecomment-6011082459)および更新後[ui#322](https://github.com/roccho-dev/ui/issues/322)でP/R/W3が再討議中。application用入力adapterと小さなexample用fixture adapterが共有UIをconsumeする境界、capability coverage、physical差分tree、検証を固定する。

旧v2の「UI read-model/projection/build/fixture/全部の受入testをappsへ移す」想定は本v4により置換する。物理移行は本Issueでactual domain source・公開UI distribution/API・thin consumer配置を独立inventoryし、必要なUI sourceを人間が採用した後、本Issue固有の認識合わせ/GOで開始する。未存在の実OCI producerを作成済みと扱わず、共有UIのコピー/逆依存を作らない。

旧v2の「Atlas screen/read-model/projection/builder/testsを8ファイルまとめてappsへ移す」想定は、Humanのapplication-use-case訂正とv4の実source監査により置換する。画面をexampleへコピーしたりUI→apps逆依存を作らない。

{"body":"# voice-ui 総合意思伝達 workspace

Userの2026-10-03指示により、このIssueをvoice-uiの総合意思伝達・各自主張・相互反証・合意の掲示板として使用する。「Issueは目的定義だけ、相互反証はPR上だけ」という通常規約への本件限定の例外であり、他Issue・他scopeへ一般化しない。

## 現在の設計状態

**DESIGN AGREED — 完成WHAT / apps-owned stable dirtree / 最小差分 / 動作試験の合格条件 / 小さく美しい品質 / 完成までのプロセス。P/R/Wの設計残件0。**

独立主張→相互反証→補正後の第3反復により、以下の同じ案へP/R/Wが合意した。

- [採択したP統合案：完成定義・dirtree・試験・工程](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5961238302)
- [R第3：自己投稿・設計残件0](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5961257885)
- [W第3：自己投稿・設計残件0](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5961260897)
- [R第2反証](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5961186914) / [W第2反証](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5961185346)
- [責務境界の先行合意](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5960715618)
- [失効した旧案：履歴のみ、実装根拠にしない](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5960126489)

appsはweb PRODUCTのInput / Selection / Buffer / app-domain候補・source grounding / Projection / Commit request / authoritative result-current表示を持つ。native/Vim/goshは別責務。apps-owned physical accepted store/global reducer/placeholder providerは新設しない。既存flat treeとsession.apply({commit}) seam、/api/judgeを活かす。

完成試験はpure/API/static、controlled browser、Commit seam、context-dependent multi-turn実Jev、artifact shape、actual authority、final正式同一物に分ける。単発HTTP200・whole構造図・fixture・source-dev・RED_EXPECTED boundaryをreal conversation/正式提供/全完成へ昇格しない。final同じPRODUCT bytes/正式entry/ACCEPTANCEで実Jev→図更新とactual Commit→confirm→reload/fresh currentとP実画面を検証する。実マイクは今回NOT_RUN。

### 採択した工程

設計freeze → web source差分・controlled検証 → context-dependent実Jev Working検証 → architecture artifact-shape提供gapを閉じる → external accepted readiness確認 → ready時one cutover → reviewed final sourceから正式提供 → 同じ正式artifactで最終実証 → R/W独立完成評価。

ordinary FAILは証拠を残し同scopeで是正・同gate再検証。scope/authority/permission変更やexternal effect UNKNOWNは越境/blind retryせずPへ。

external accepted owner / published contract / usable bindingはTBD。stable web treeは合意済みだが、実bindingのphysical leafは公開契約がreadyになった時に最小consumer差分として確定する。未提供ならcutoverと全完成だけHOLD。先にできるweb/source/Jev/artifact-shape未完を外部WAITへ転嫁しない。

旧localStorage保存はcutover前legacyとして無断破壊せず、target適合PASSに使わない。ready後one cutoverでbrowser accepted read/writeを非到達にし、dual write / auto migration / accepted fallbackなし。

**設計合意 ≠ 実装・試験済み。** 新完成形のIMPLEMENTED / CI_PASS / REAL_JEV_PASS / ARTIFACT_SHAPE_READY / FORMAL_ARTIFACT_PROVIDED / ACCEPTED_INTEGRATION_PASSは今回成立させていない。現formalのarchitecture供給gapとreal Jevの未達を未完として保持する。今回code/build/live/merge/release/認証変更0。User受容・Issue close・公開操作許可は設計合意と別。

## 担当

- P/D：このCodex rootが兼務する。local.workはこのactorのみ。ローカル実装・試験・Git操作もこのactorが行う。
- R：[r](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-p-6abffc5a993c81918fe3231a75407780/c/6abffc5e-3e0c-83ee-9a5d-df07df61b229) — 独立評価・反証・系列の完成確認。
- W：[w](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-p-6abffc5a993c81918fe3231a75407780/c/6abffd06-6ac8-83ee-aefa-f3809371e8ab) — 設計・変更案・試験案の作成と改善。

R/Wは既存web.chatを再利用する。User指定はweb.chat.latest.xhigh（Extra High）。送信前にthread identityと実表示を確認し、web.workやlocal R/Wへ黙示切替しない。この本文の作成だけではR/Wの起動・確認・合意済みとは扱わない。

## 記録と進め方

- 本文：目的・制約・許可境界と、採択された現在の合意。既存の目的・完成条件はこの掲示板を作るだけでは変更しない。
- コメント：各actor自身の主張・反証・修正理由・合意可否・残件。相手の実投稿を自読し、P/DはR/Wの技術本文をchat間で中継・代筆しない。
- PR：実装差分・対象head・check・実証証拠の実体。このIssueから参照し、同じ技術snapshotを二重管理しない。
- chat：Issue・comment・PR/reviewへの短い参照による発火。全文配送・ACK列・作業実況は増やさない。

完成形とdirtree → 品質（小さく美しいか）→ 開発・運用プロセスの順に、各自主張・相互反証・改善を反復する。新たな実装への着手前に、完成条件・scope・操作許可・適用版・三者の合意を固定する。

合意、操作許可、実装完了、CI Green、実Jev成功、Userの最終受容は別とする。通常の技術FAILは許可内の是正loopで扱い、scope変更・許可不足・作用不明はPへ戻す。

## 維持する境界

- 開発・build・検証はWSLC OCI内のworktreeで完結する。Windowsは表示・transportのみ。
- 共有OCI接続・旧8787は維持する。境界変更が必要なら操作前にUserへエスカレーションする。
- Cloudflareは本件scope外。並行するwindows#8/#14へ越境しない。
- 秘密・credential・生のprovider応答は投稿しない。
- 掲示板の使用許可だけで、code変更・merge・release・deploy・認証変更・Issue closeの許可を追加しない。

## Scope and meta completion contract

Userの2026-10-03 JST追記指示による整理。[三者採択原本](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5961238302)の完成条件は変更せず、限定フェーズ完了・全体目的達成・残件引継ぎを区別する。

### Scope — 正本と責務

| 正本 | 記載する責務 | 現在状態／終了条件 |
|---|---|---|
| [PR47](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/47) | 文脈依存シナリオの検査器実装。source/CIと実Jev結果を分離 | sourceレビュー・CI PASS、Draft/unmerged。merge・canonical事後readbackでこの実装sliceを完了 |
| [PR47の既存TODO](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/47#deferred-todo--jev-correction-http400) | 観測した特定の文脈付き訂正リクエストの400 | DEFERRED_BY_USER。期限・失敗証拠・再開条件は同TODOが正本。追加診断/再試行なし、未解決/NOT_MET保持 |
| 後継apps Issue（案） | **voice-ui: Accepted/current契約消費と最終統合実証** | まだ未作成。owner・公開contract・usable binding未提供。接続先や引継ぎ完了を仮定しない |
| 本Issue #46 | 全体目的・責務分割・達成証拠・未達・終了判定 | 正本へのリンクで追跡。現在OPEN、全体目的未達 |

400は全Jev停止ではなく、観測した後続訂正リクエストの失敗。Accepted/current契約待ちは確定保存・復元の境界であり、会話→Jev→Working図更新の必要条件ではない。「外部」はappsと別のauthority責務であり、外部クラウド/Cloudflareを必要とする意味ではない。

### 後継Issueへ引き継ぐ内容

- 前提：appsはconsumer。physical accepted authorityやplaceholder/fallbackを新設しない。
- 未提供：実owner、公開契約、usable binding、confirm/refuse/unknown/currentの観測保証。未定は未定とする。
- 再開条件：上記のexact実体をreadbackできること。再開担当は本scopeのP/root、独立完成評価は既存の固定web R/W。
- 再開後：最小consumer接続→実確認後だけAccepted反映→旧browser accepted保存経路撤去→reload/fresh current実証→正式同一PRODUCT/ACCEPTANCEで最終統合・独立評価。
- 除外：400診断、Cloudflare/windows#8/#14、native/Vim/gosh、Noctty、新認証・秘密閲覧、実マイク。400に関する未達証拠は既存TODOに残し、必須実証から黙示免除しない。

### Meta — Issue全体に求めること

| 項目 | 求める記載 |
|---|---|
| 目的 | 指定source・以前の会話・Workingを踏まえた実Jev評価→実図更新と、採択済みの確定保存/復元・正式同一物実証 |
| 責務分割 | apps内部、外部契約消費、400保留をそれぞれ正本へのリンクで示す |
| 達成証拠 | 設計合意・実装・controlled test・CI・merge/readback・正式配布物・実サービス実証を区別 |
| 未達管理 | 残件ごとのowner、次の入力、再開条件。未定を隠さず、期限到来で解決/PASS/自動再開にしない |
| 終了判定 | 目的達成、限定フェーズ完了、後継への引継ぎのどれなのかを明記 |

apps内部フェーズは対象差分のreview/gates/merge・事後確認後に限定完了とする。現在PR47未mergeのため未完。区切り後の報告は **「apps内部フェーズ完了／外部契約消費は後継Issueで待機／400は期限付き保留／全体目的未達」** とし、条件が揃う前は該当項目を未完と記録する。

本メタを目的達成として閉じるには採択された必須実証・独立完成評価が必要。限定フェーズ終了/引継ぎとして閉じる場合は、残る全体目的を追う実在する親/後継Issue、引継ぎ先、未達・再開条件を明示する。後継未作成の現在、引継ぎ済みとはしない。

今回の作用は本文追記だけ。新規Issue作成、merge/release/dispatch/deploy、追加live診断、Issue close、R/Wの新たな合意済みclaimは行わない。
"}

{"body":"# voice-ui 総合意思伝達 workspace

Userの2026-10-03指示により、このIssueをvoice-uiの総合意思伝達・各自主張・相互反証・合意の掲示板として使用する。「Issueは目的定義だけ、相互反証はPR上だけ」という通常規約への本件限定の例外であり、他Issue・他scopeへ一般化しない。

## 現在の設計状態

**DESIGN AGREED — 完成WHAT / apps-owned stable dirtree / 最小差分 / 動作試験の合格条件 / 小さく美しい品質 / 完成までのプロセス。P/R/Wの設計残件0。**

独立主張→相互反証→補正後の第3反復により、以下の同じ案へP/R/Wが合意した。

- [採択したP統合案：完成定義・dirtree・試験・工程](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5961238302)
- [R第3：自己投稿・設計残件0](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5961257885)
- [W第3：自己投稿・設計残件0](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5961260897)
- [R第2反証](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5961186914) / [W第2反証](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5961185346)
- [責務境界の先行合意](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5960715618)
- [失効した旧案：履歴のみ、実装根拠にしない](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5960126489)

appsはweb PRODUCTのInput / Selection / Buffer / app-domain候補・source grounding / Projection / Commit request / authoritative result-current表示を持つ。native/Vim/goshは別責務。apps-owned physical accepted store/global reducer/placeholder providerは新設しない。既存flat treeとsession.apply({commit}) seam、/api/judgeを活かす。

完成試験はpure/API/static、controlled browser、Commit seam、context-dependent multi-turn実Jev、artifact shape、actual authority、final正式同一物に分ける。単発HTTP200・whole構造図・fixture・source-dev・RED_EXPECTED boundaryをreal conversation/正式提供/全完成へ昇格しない。final同じPRODUCT bytes/正式entry/ACCEPTANCEで実Jev→図更新とactual Commit→confirm→reload/fresh currentとP実画面を検証する。実マイクは今回NOT_RUN。

### 採択した工程

設計freeze → web source差分・controlled検証 → context-dependent実Jev Working検証 → architecture artifact-shape提供gapを閉じる → external accepted readiness確認 → ready時one cutover → reviewed final sourceから正式提供 → 同じ正式artifactで最終実証 → R/W独立完成評価。

ordinary FAILは証拠を残し同scopeで是正・同gate再検証。scope/authority/permission変更やexternal effect UNKNOWNは越境/blind retryせずPへ。

external accepted owner / published contract / usable bindingはTBD。stable web treeは合意済みだが、実bindingのphysical leafは公開契約がreadyになった時に最小consumer差分として確定する。未提供ならcutoverと全完成だけHOLD。先にできるweb/source/Jev/artifact-shape未完を外部WAITへ転嫁しない。

旧localStorage保存はcutover前legacyとして無断破壊せず、target適合PASSに使わない。ready後one cutoverでbrowser accepted read/writeを非到達にし、dual write / auto migration / accepted fallbackなし。

**設計合意 ≠ 実装・試験済み。** 新完成形のIMPLEMENTED / CI_PASS / REAL_JEV_PASS / ARTIFACT_SHAPE_READY / FORMAL_ARTIFACT_PROVIDED / ACCEPTED_INTEGRATION_PASSは今回成立させていない。現formalのarchitecture供給gapとreal Jevの未達を未完として保持する。今回code/build/live/merge/release/認証変更0。User受容・Issue close・公開操作許可は設計合意と別。

## 担当

- P/D：このCodex rootが兼務する。local.workはこのactorのみ。ローカル実装・試験・Git操作もこのactorが行う。
- R：[r](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-p-6abffc5a993c81918fe3231a75407780/c/6abffc5e-3e0c-83ee-9a5d-df07df61b229) — 独立評価・反証・系列の完成確認。
- W：[w](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-p-6abffc5a993c81918fe3231a75407780/c/6abffd06-6ac8-83ee-aefa-f3809371e8ab) — 設計・変更案・試験案の作成と改善。

R/Wは既存web.chatを再利用する。User指定はweb.chat.latest.xhigh（Extra High）。送信前にthread identityと実表示を確認し、web.workやlocal R/Wへ黙示切替しない。この本文の作成だけではR/Wの起動・確認・合意済みとは扱わない。

## 記録と進め方

- 本文：目的・制約・許可境界と、採択された現在の合意。既存の目的・完成条件はこの掲示板を作るだけでは変更しない。
- コメント：各actor自身の主張・反証・修正理由・合意可否・残件。相手の実投稿を自読し、P/DはR/Wの技術本文をchat間で中継・代筆しない。
- PR：実装差分・対象head・check・実証証拠の実体。このIssueから参照し、同じ技術snapshotを二重管理しない。
- chat：Issue・comment・PR/reviewへの短い参照による発火。全文配送・ACK列・作業実況は増やさない。

完成形とdirtree → 品質（小さく美しいか）→ 開発・運用プロセスの順に、各自主張・相互反証・改善を反復する。新たな実装への着手前に、完成条件・scope・操作許可・適用版・三者の合意を固定する。

合意、操作許可、実装完了、CI Green、実Jev成功、Userの最終受容は別とする。通常の技術FAILは許可内の是正loopで扱い、scope変更・許可不足・作用不明はPへ戻す。

## 維持する境界

- 開発・build・検証はWSLC OCI内のworktreeで完結する。Windowsは表示・transportのみ。
- 共有OCI接続・旧8787は維持する。境界変更が必要なら操作前にUserへエスカレーションする。
- Cloudflareは本件scope外。並行するwindows#8/#14へ越境しない。
- 秘密・credential・生のprovider応答は投稿しない。
- 掲示板の使用許可だけで、code変更・merge・release・deploy・認証変更・Issue closeの許可を追加しない。

## Scope and meta completion contract

Userの2026-10-03 JST追記指示による整理。[三者採択原本](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46#issuecomment-5961238302)の完成条件は変更せず、限定フェーズ完了・全体目的達成・残件引継ぎを区別する。

### Scope — 正本と責務

| 正本 | 記載する責務 | 現在状態／終了条件 |
|---|---|---|
| [PR47](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/47) | 文脈依存シナリオの検査器実装。source/CIと実Jev結果を分離 | sourceレビュー・CI PASS、Draft/unmerged。merge・canonical事後readbackでこの実装sliceを完了 |
| [PR47の既存TODO](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/47#deferred-todo--jev-correction-http400) | 観測した特定の文脈付き訂正リクエストの400 | DEFERRED_BY_USER。期限・失敗証拠・再開条件は同TODOが正本。追加診断/再試行なし、未解決/NOT_MET保持 |
| 後継apps Issue（案） | **voice-ui: Accepted/current契約消費と最終統合実証** | まだ未作成。owner・公開contract・usable binding未提供。接続先や引継ぎ完了を仮定しない |
| 本Issue #46 | 全体目的・責務分割・達成証拠・未達・終了判定 | 正本へのリンクで追跡。現在OPEN、全体目的未達 |

400は全Jev停止ではなく、観測した後続訂正リクエストの失敗。Accepted/current契約待ちは確定保存・復元の境界であり、会話→Jev→Working図更新の必要条件ではない。「外部」はappsと別のauthority責務であり、外部クラウド/Cloudflareを必要とする意味ではない。

- 再開条件：上記のexact実体をreadbackできること。再開担当は本scopeのP/root、独立完成評価は既存の固定web R/W。
- 再開後：最小consumer接続→実確認後だけAccepted反映→旧browser accepted保存経路撤去→reload/fresh current実証→正式同一PRODUCT/ACCEPTANCEで最終統合・独立評価。
- 除外：400診断、Cloudflare/windows#8/#14、native/Vim/gosh、Noctty、新認証・秘密閲覧、実マイク。400に関する未達証拠は既存TODOに残し、必須実証から黙示免除しない。

| 項目 | 求める記載 |
|---|---|
| 目的 | 指定source・以前の会話・Workingを踏まえた実Jev評価→実図更新と、採択済みの確定保存/復元・正式同一物実証 |
| 責務分割 | apps内部、外部契約消費、400保留をそれぞれ正本へのリンクで示す |
| 達成証拠 | 設計合意・実装・controlled test・CI・merge/readback・正式配布物・実サービス実証を区別 |
| 未達管理 | 残件ごとのowner、次の入力、再開条件。未定を隠さず、期限到来で解決/PASS/自動再開にしない |
| 終了判定 | 目的達成、限定フェーズ完了、後継への引継ぎのどれなのかを明記 |

apps内部フェーズは対象差分のreview/gates/merge・事後確認後に限定完了とする。現在PR47未mergeのため未完。区切り後の報告は **「apps内部フェーズ完了／外部契約消費は後継Issueで待機／400は期限付き保留／全体目的未達」** とし、条件が揃う前は該当項目を未完と記録する。

本メタを目的達成として閉じるには採択された必須実証・独立完成評価が必要。限定フェーズ終了/引継ぎとして閉じる場合は、残る全体目的を追う実在する親/後継Issue、引継ぎ先、未達・再開条件を明示する。後継未作成の現在、引継ぎ済みとはしない。

今回の作用は本文追記だけ。新規Issue作成、merge/release/dispatch/deploy、追加live診断、Issue close、R/Wの新たな合意済みclaimは行わない。

{"body":"## Purpose

Allow reviewed modeling proposals to become `hq.modelCommitQueued.v1` rows only through an explicit human promotion gate.

## Scope

- Add proposal-to-model-queue promotion command/tool in ops.
- Require explicit confirmation input.
- Preserve proposal evidence in the generated model queue row.
- Validate promoted row with the ops hq queue validator.

## Done

- reviewed proposal -> modelCommitQueued row.
- unreviewed/unconfirmed proposal fails.
- promoted row passes ops validator.
- output remains queue intent, not accepted ledger.

## Scope-achievement declaration

This issue is complete only when all of the following are true:

- Purpose lineage: directly connects agent proposals to human-confirmed model queue while preserving admission as a separate later step.
- Core/port/adapter: promotion decision and queue row construction are pure core; proposal/queue read/write are ports; file/CLI IO is adapter.
- Pure/effect split: human confirmation validation and output row construction are pure; storage/reporting side effects are adapter-only.
- False-positive exclusion: reviewed and explicitly confirmed proposals must promote into valid modelCommit queue rows.
- False-negative exclusion: unreviewed, unconfirmed, stale, malformed, or authority-bearing proposals must not promote.
- Authority boundary: promoted output is still queue intent and not accepted ledger state.
- Repo cleanliness: promotion gate lives in ops and does not enter edits command vocabulary or ui proposal display.

## Non-goals

- Do not auto-promote.
- Do not write accepted ledger.
- Do not run real agents.

## Checks

- proposal -> queue promotion pass.
- missing human confirmation reject.
- promoted queue validation check.
- known FP/FN promotion fixtures.
- Existing ops checks pass.

## Depends on

- #40
- #47

## Why this matters

This preserves the human decision boundary between agent proposals and model commits."}

request.text:
{"body":"## Purpose

Allow reviewed modeling proposals to become `hq.modelCommitQueued.v1` rows only through an explicit human promotion gate.

## Scope

- Add proposal-to-model-queue promotion command/tool in ops.
- Require explicit confirmation input.
- Preserve proposal evidence in the generated model queue row.
- Validate promoted row with the ops hq queue validator.

## Done

- reviewed proposal -> modelCommitQueued row.
- unreviewed/unconfirmed proposal fails.
- promoted row passes ops validator.
- output remains queue intent, not accepted ledger.

## Scope-achievement declaration

This issue is complete only when all of the following are true:

- Purpose lineage: directly connects agent proposals to human-confirmed model queue while preserving admission as a separate later step.
- Core/port/adapter: promotion decision and queue row construction are pure core; proposal/queue read/write are ports; file/CLI IO is adapter.
- Pure/effect split: human confirmation validation and output row construction are pure; storage/reporting side effects are adapter-only.
- False-positive exclusion: reviewed and explicitly confirmed proposals must promote into valid modelCommit queue rows.
- False-negative exclusion: unreviewed, unconfirmed, stale, malformed, or authority-bearing proposals must not promote.
- Authority boundary: promoted output is still queue intent and not accepted ledger state.
- Repo cleanliness: promotion gate lives in ops and does not enter edits command vocabulary or ui proposal display.

## Non-goals

- Do not auto-promote.
- Do not write accepted ledger.
- Do not run real agents.

## Checks

- proposal -> queue promotion pass.
- missing human confirmation reject.
- promoted queue validation check.
- known FP/FN promotion fixtures.
- Existing ops checks pass.

## Depends on

- #40
- #47

## Why this matters

This preserves the human decision boundary between agent proposals and model commits."}

{"body":"Refs roccho-dev/adrs#269
Refs roccho-dev/flakes#105
Refs roccho-dev/envs#85

record: OPS_HOMELESS_CONVERGENCE_001
record_type: active_product_migration_issue
status: ACTIVE
manual_owner_gate_required: false

## Purpose

Using only exact `flakes` PackagePrimitives, exact `envs` desired-state outputs, and a verified private host wrapper, prove that every required target can be realized and recovered without `home`.

`ops` owns the effectful lifecycle:

```text
prepare
apply
observe
verify
second apply
no-change verify
failure injection
rollback
post-rollback observe
receipt
```

## Authority boundary

`ops` must not independently decide or redefine:

- package source, version, hash, or identity;
- desired state, target scope, or package binding;
- host-private credentials or secret contents;
- accepted architecture decisions.

`ops` may own:

- operational runners and effect adapters;
- target-native observation adapters;
- rollback adapters;
- fleet scheduling;
- repo-local operational packages and checks;
- sanitized public receipt projections.

It must not duplicate product packages produced by `flakes`.

## Required target set

Do not infer targets locally. Consume the active-consumer and target-class inventory from `HOME_ZERO_CONSUMER_001` under `roccho-dev/adrs#269`.

Every required target class must pass before the overall verdict can be PASS.

## Proof sequence

For each target class:

1. verify a clean or bounded starting state;
2. verify exact `flakes` revision/output and PackagePrimitive identity;
3. verify exact `envs` desired-state ID, digest, and plan;
4. verify private-wrapper identity and digest;
5. generate and retain the pre-effect plan;
6. apply;
7. observe through target-native interfaces;
8. compare observation with desired state;
9. reapply identical inputs;
10. prove change count is zero;
11. inject one bounded failure;
12. observe the failure;
13. execute rollback;
14. observe after rollback;
15. prove return to the recorded safe state;
16. search again for any runtime or resolver dependency on `home`.

## Credential and disclosure boundary

Do not publish host names, private IP/domain values, raw credentials, customer identifiers, private wrapper contents, or secret paths.

Public receipts may contain only:

```text
target_class
opaque_target_id
input digests
sanitized checks
result status
private evidence permalink/digest
```

Exact private evidence belongs in private ADRS.

## Fail closed

Do not apply when any of these is true:

```text
desired-state digest mismatch
producer revision/output mismatch
private-wrapper digest mismatch
wrong target class
stale observation
required credential reference missing
rollback plan missing
active writer conflict
precondition mismatch
```

Never blindly retry an ambiguous external effect.

## Acceptance

For every required target class:

```text
prepare = pass
apply = pass
native_observe = pass
expected_state_match = pass
second_apply_change_count = 0
failure_observed = pass
rollback = pass
post_rollback_observe = pass
home_reference_count = 0
ambient_path_dependency_count = 0
raw_secret_output_count = 0
```

Overall:

```text
required_target_classes_unproven = 0
desired_state_redefined_in_ops = 0
product_package_duplicates = 0
unclassified_effects = 0
fresh_independent_review = pass
```

## Receipt

Append to `roccho-dev/adrs#269`:

```text
OPS_HOMELESS_CONVERGENCE_001
exact_ops_revision
exact_flakes_inputs
exact_envs_input
private_wrapper_digest
required_target_set_digest
per_target_results
second_apply_results
failure_and_rollback_results
home_reference_search
limitations
verdict
```

## Terminal states

```text
PASS
BLOCKED_BY_TARGET
BLOCKED_BY_INPUT
ROLLBACK_UNPROVEN
```

An apply success alone is not completion."}

request.text:
{"body":"Refs roccho-dev/adrs#269
Refs roccho-dev/flakes#105
Refs roccho-dev/envs#85

record: OPS_HOMELESS_CONVERGENCE_001
record_type: active_product_migration_issue
status: ACTIVE
manual_owner_gate_required: false

## Purpose

Using only exact `flakes` PackagePrimitives, exact `envs` desired-state outputs, and a verified private host wrapper, prove that every required target can be realized and recovered without `home`.

`ops` owns the effectful lifecycle:

```text
prepare
apply
observe
verify
second apply
no-change verify
failure injection
rollback
post-rollback observe
receipt
```

## Authority boundary

`ops` must not independently decide or redefine:

- package source, version, hash, or identity;
- desired state, target scope, or package binding;
- host-private credentials or secret contents;
- accepted architecture decisions.

`ops` may own:

- operational runners and effect adapters;
- target-native observation adapters;
- rollback adapters;
- fleet scheduling;
- repo-local operational packages and checks;
- sanitized public receipt projections.

It must not duplicate product packages produced by `flakes`.

## Required target set

Do not infer targets locally. Consume the active-consumer and target-class inventory from `HOME_ZERO_CONSUMER_001` under `roccho-dev/adrs#269`.

Every required target class must pass before the overall verdict can be PASS.

## Proof sequence

For each target class:

1. verify a clean or bounded starting state;
2. verify exact `flakes` revision/output and PackagePrimitive identity;
3. verify exact `envs` desired-state ID, digest, and plan;
4. verify private-wrapper identity and digest;
5. generate and retain the pre-effect plan;
6. apply;
7. observe through target-native interfaces;
8. compare observation with desired state;
9. reapply identical inputs;
10. prove change count is zero;
11. inject one bounded failure;
12. observe the failure;
13. execute rollback;
14. observe after rollback;
15. prove return to the recorded safe state;
16. search again for any runtime or resolver dependency on `home`.

## Credential and disclosure boundary

Do not publish host names, private IP/domain values, raw credentials, customer identifiers, private wrapper contents, or secret paths.

Public receipts may contain only:

```text
target_class
opaque_target_id
input digests
sanitized checks
result status
private evidence permalink/digest
```

Exact private evidence belongs in private ADRS.

## Fail closed

Do not apply when any of these is true:

```text
desired-state digest mismatch
producer revision/output mismatch
private-wrapper digest mismatch
wrong target class
stale observation
required credential reference missing
rollback plan missing
active writer conflict
precondition mismatch
```

Never blindly retry an ambiguous external effect.

## Acceptance

For every required target class:

```text
prepare = pass
apply = pass
native_observe = pass
expected_state_match = pass
second_apply_change_count = 0
failure_observed = pass
rollback = pass
post_rollback_observe = pass
home_reference_count = 0
ambient_path_dependency_count = 0
raw_secret_output_count = 0
```

Overall:

```text
required_target_classes_unproven = 0
desired_state_redefined_in_ops = 0
product_package_duplicates = 0
unclassified_effects = 0
fresh_independent_review = pass
```

## Receipt

Append to `roccho-dev/adrs#269`:

```text
OPS_HOMELESS_CONVERGENCE_001
exact_ops_revision
exact_flakes_inputs
exact_envs_input
private_wrapper_digest
required_target_set_digest
per_target_results
second_apply_results
failure_and_rollback_results
home_reference_search
limitations
verdict
```

## Terminal states

```text
PASS
BLOCKED_BY_TARGET
BLOCKED_BY_INPUT
ROLLBACK_UNPROVEN
```

An apply success alone is not completion."}

{"body":"## Canonical completion — 2026-09-23

Status: **IMPLEMENTED / CANONICAL**

```text
ops#397
  → merged to proposals
  → merge fdb3fb109596eca6e8116f36121ef867ae5d4a62

envs#112
  → auth-runtime = envctl + pinned sops

envs#110
  → envs-owned authenticated 7-repo execution

apps#8
  → generic artifact.auth.v1 / jev-api declaration
```

### Final responsibility

```text
ops
  = deterministic repository observation
  + shared Jev semantic evaluation
  + repo-health projection / receipt

envs
  = auth/environment authority
  + auth-runtime / auth-bundle
  + authenticated effect/readback

Jev
  = semantic evidence only
```

### Final semantic contract

The original V1 `Noul → threshold → PASS/FAIL` plan below is **historical and superseded**.

Current implementation:

```text
deterministic facts
→ deterministicStatus

semantic concerns
→ shared jev-review
→ raw Noul findings
→ semanticStatus = EVALUATED | ERROR | BLOCKED

Noul authority = false
```

Completion means observation/evaluation coverage closed with no execution error/block, **not** that a Noul magnitude grants PASS/FAIL authority.

### Physical proof

Real envs-owned run:

https://github.com/roccho-dev/envs/actions/runs/35713982312

```text
expected       = 7
received       = 7
completeCount  = 7
complete       = true

adrs        PASS / EVALUATED
governance  PASS / EVALUATED
ops         PASS / EVALUATED
ui          PASS / EVALUATED
envs        PASS / EVALUATED
flakes      PASS / EVALUATED
chatgpt     PASS / EVALUATED

model         = jev-1.13.0
authority     = false
noulAuthority = false
```

A later canonical-SHA refresh attempt is tracked separately in `envs#125`; its Actions jobs did not start and therefore are **not** treated as new evidence. This does not change the completed implementation boundary recorded here.

---

<details>
<summary>Historical V1 planning record (superseded where it conflicts with the canonical completion above)</summary>

## Purpose

Scope purpose is **major repository health**.

Target repositories are exactly:

```text
roccho-dev/adrs
roccho-dev/governance
roccho-dev/ops
roccho-dev/ui
roccho-dev/envs
roccho-dev/flakes
roccho-dev/chatgpt
```

The purpose is not to use Jev and not to generate HTML.

```text
7 major repositories
→ deterministic observation
→ semantic health judgment only where deterministic checks are insufficient
→ fail-closed aggregation
→ one minimal human report
→ exact evidence/readback
```

This contributes upward to a self-checking agent factory, lower transfer/DD cost, and ultimately a more transferable high-value company.

## Purpose lineage

| Generation | Purpose |
|---:|---|
| G0 | Observe all 7 target repositories without silent omission |
| G1 | Structure current repo/package facts |
| G2 | Separate deterministic facts from semantic judgment |
| G3 | Use Jev only for semantic health propositions |
| G4 | Never convert FAIL / UNKNOWN into Green |
| G5 | Reach the unhealthy repo/package and reason from one report |
| G6 | Reproduce from exact repo SHAs / rules / judgments |
| G7 | Reuse the same package from one-shot CI and local execution |
| G8 | Allow a fresh evaluator to inspect health without founder memory |
| G9 | Reduce maintenance / transfer / DD cost |
| G10 | Provide a shared self-check surface for the agent factory |
| meta | Contribute indirectly to high-value company construction and sale |

## V1 health boundary

V1 evaluates only:

```text
purpose alignment
ownership / responsibility overlap
active structure consistency
test / evidence closure
claim / status truthfulness
```

It does **not** claim complete source-code correctness, security, performance, or universal lint coverage.

New health dimensions should extend `rules.jsonl`; they must not create a second package/workflow for the same purpose.

## Existing assets to reuse

Do not create a second inventory/governance system.

Reuse current deterministic sources and package conventions where applicable:

- `ops/build/packages.jsonl`
- `ops/build/checks.jsonl`
- `ops-package-responses`
- `ops-gov-package-output`
- repository-native package/inventory evidence
- existing GitHub repository access
- `envs#101 / #102` Environment-scoped auth capability projection
- existing UI package-map visual language only; no new UI runtime in V1

Important historical correction:

An old `adrs#331` comment refers to `ops#364` as an organization-map RED PR, but the current actual `ops#364` is a different gov-release-proxy PR, and the current ops tree does not contain `verification/organization-map`. Do not treat that historical comment as an implemented dependency.

## Responsibility

```text
envs
  = auth capability / encrypted secret authority

ops/packages/repo-health
  = observation + Jev orchestration + health reduction

Jev
  = semantic is? judgment only

GitHub
  = repository source

generated report
  = non-authority evidence projection
```

Jev must not own repository/package discovery, secret management, or HTML generation.

## Final tree

```text
envs/
├─ bindings/
│  └─ auth.jsonl
├─ environments/
│  └─ local.jsonl
├─ secrets/
│  └─ jev-api-key.sops.yaml
├─ cmd/envctl/
│  ├─ auth.go
│  └─ auth_test.go
└─ .github/workflows/
   └─ local-auth-bundle.yml
      # reuse envs#101/#102


ops/
├─ packages/
│  └─ repo-health/
│     ├─ artifact.jsonl
│     ├─ scope.jsonl
│     ├─ rules.jsonl
│     ├─ bin/
│     │  └─ repo-health.mjs
│     ├─ lib/
│     │  └─ core.mjs
│     └─ tests/
│        ├─ cases.jsonl
│        ├─ destructive.jsonl
│        └─ run.mjs
├─ build/
│  ├─ packages.jsonl
│  └─ checks.jsonl
├─ ci.intent.v1.jsonl
└─ .github/workflows/
   └─ repo-health.yml


generated CI artifact/
└─ repo-health/
   ├─ report.jsonl
   ├─ receipt.json
   └─ index.html
```

No V1 source change is required in `adrs / governance / ui / flakes / chatgpt`.

## Auth contract prerequisite

The auth work already exists as `envs#101/#102` paired with `apps#7/#8`.

Before treating it as a shared artifact contract, normalize the currently app-specific/secret-specific names while those PRs are still Draft:

```text
apps.artifactAuth.v1
→ artifact.auth.v1

jev-api-key capability
→ jev-api capability
```

The implementation binding remains:

```text
jev-api
→ secrets/jev-api-key.sops.yaml
→ JEV_API_KEY
```

Capability name must describe capability, not secret storage.

`repo-health/artifact.jsonl` declares only required non-secret capabilities.

If existing GitHub authorization cannot read all seven repositories, add one explicit `github-repo-read` capability. Never treat unreadable repositories as empty repositories.

## Execution flow

```text
scope.jsonl
→ exact observation of 7 repositories
→ repo SHA / tree / package surfaces / declarations / checks / evidence
→ deterministic validation
→ rules.jsonl × subject
→ Jev is?
→ PASS / FAIL / UNKNOWN
→ repo/package aggregation
→ report.jsonl
→ receipt.json
→ deterministic index.html
```

Deterministic facts stay deterministic.

Examples:

```text
repo exists?
exact SHA?
package surface exists?
required declaration present?
evidence exists?
```

Jev handles semantic questions only:

```text
Does implementation contradict declared purpose?
Is responsibility duplicated?
Does the work close through test/evidence?
Does a claim exceed its evidence?
```

V1 requires only the `is?` primitive.

## Status contract

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| PASS | deterministic checks pass and all blocking semantic rules pass |
| FAIL | explicit deterministic or semantic contradiction |
| UNKNOWN | repo unavailable, required subject missing, Jev failure/timeout/invalid response, or undecidable threshold region |

observed repos = 7
unreadable repos = 0
blocking FAIL = 0
blocking UNKNOWN = 0
rules missing = 0
Jev execution errors = 0
secret leakage = 0
report / receipt validation = PASS

observed 7/7 | fail N | unknown N

│  package-a   PASS
│  package-b   PASS
└─

┌─ governance ─ FAIL
│  package-a   PASS
│  package-b   FAIL

└─

- repo: name + PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN;

3. mixed repository revisions;
4. duplicated repo identity;
5. missing/empty rules;
6. implicit threshold;
7. Jev timeout;
8. Jev API error;

## Scope

- Use a ui-style targetRef fixture.
- Use an edits-style confirmed command/queue row fixture.

- ops worker receipt references the queue row and targetRef.
- mismatch fixtures fail.
- No ui or edits state is mutated by ops proof.

- Do not run a real browser.
- Do not run Vim.
- Do not render HTML.
- Do not write accepted ledger.

- mismatch digest check fails as expected.

- #41

- roccho-dev/edits#51
- roccho-dev/edits#52
- roccho-dev/ui#128

{"body":"## Purpose

Represent agent output as a non-authority modeling proposal.

## Scope

- Define `modeling.proposal.v1` schema in ops.
- Include source agent task id, targetRef, proposed operation, evidence, acceptance criteria, and status.
- Add valid/invalid fixtures.
- Keep proposal separate from model queue and accepted ledger.

## Done

- Valid proposal fixture passes.
- Missing evidence/target/proposed operation fails where required.
- Proposal cannot contain accepted/admitted/ledger authority fields.
- Docs state proposals require human promotion before model queue.

## Scope-achievement declaration

This issue is complete only when all of the following are true:

- Purpose lineage: supports agent-assisted modeling while keeping human confirmation and accepted-ledger admission explicit.
- Core/port/adapter: proposal schema and validation are pure core; proposal storage/readback is port/adapter; UI rendering is outside ops.
- Pure/effect split: proposal validation and digesting are pure; file IO/reporting are adapter-only.
- False-positive exclusion: valid proposal fixtures with evidence and target context must pass.
- False-negative exclusion: proposals with missing evidence, missing target, authority fields, accepted-state claims, or direct ledger mutations must fail.
- Authority boundary: proposals are non-authority evidence and cannot be model queue or accepted ledger until explicitly promoted.
- Repo cleanliness: proposal schema must not include editor UX, UI renderer logic, or agent runner side effects.

## Non-goals

- Do not run real agents.
- Do not auto-promote proposals.
- Do not write accepted ledger.

## Checks

- proposal schema pass/fail checks.
- forbidden authority field check.
- known FP/FN proposal fixtures.
- Existing ops checks pass.

## Depends on

- #46

## Why this matters

This gives agent work a safe shape without letting agents mutate the model directly."}

request.text:
{"body":"## Purpose

Add a separate source evidence lane so observed source data does not enter the hq model queue.

The hq model queue should continue to handle model intent only. Real observations from GitHub, local resources, or remote bare repos need their own validation, receipt, and digest path.

## Solved state

| Area | Solved state |
|---|---|
| source observation | `source.observation.v1` rows are accepted only by source evidence runtime, not hq model queue |
| source receipt | `source.receipt.v1` rows record observed source, observed id, provider/surface, snapshot/readback digest, and status |
| model queue | remains model-intent only |
| source task | hq agent tasks may request observation work, but completed observation data lands in source evidence lane |
| authority | source observations and source receipts are evidence only, not model authority and not accepted ledger authority |
| adapters | GitHub/local/remote-bare reads stay in adapters, not pure core |

## Fix policy

- Keep source data out of `hq-modeling-runtime` model queue.
- Add a separate package or module for source evidence.
- Keep pure validation and digesting in core.
- Keep GitHub/local/remote-bare reads in adapters or fixtures.
- Emit deterministic receipts for all observations.
- Do not perform model/source reconciliation in this issue; that is a later lane.

## Proposed package

`packages/hq-source-evidence-runtime`

## Fix targets

| Target | Required change |
|---|---|
| `packages/hq-source-evidence-runtime/README.md` | declare purpose, boundary, source kinds, authority boundary, and examples |
| `packages/hq-source-evidence-runtime/lib/source-schema.mjs` | define `source.observation.v1` and `source.receipt.v1` shapes |
| `packages/hq-source-evidence-runtime/lib/source-validator.mjs` | validate source observations and reject authority-bearing fields |
| `packages/hq-source-evidence-runtime/lib/source-receipt-writer.mjs` | emit deterministic evidence-only receipts and digests |
| `packages/hq-source-evidence-runtime/bin/hq-source-evidence-runtime.mjs` | CLI: `validate`, `receipts`, optionally `summary` |
| `packages/hq-source-evidence-runtime/tests/source-validator.mjs` | positive and negative fixtures |
| `packages/hq-source-evidence-runtime/tests/source-receipt-writer.mjs` | receipt/digest stability and mismatch fixtures |
| `build/packages.jsonl` | register package |
| `build/checks.jsonl` | register source evidence checks |
| `docs/editor-queue-ui-ops-boundary.md` | link source evidence lane as separate from model queue |

## Minimal row shapes

### `source.observation.v1`

Required fields:

- `kind`
- `id`
- `status`
- `surface`
- `observedAt`
- `subjectRef`
- `sourceRef`
- `observation`
- `observedDigest`

Expected status values:

- `observed`
- `missing`
- `failed`

### `source.receipt.v1`

Required fields:

- `kind`
- `id`
- `status`
- `observationId`
- `surface`
- `observedDigest`
- `receiptDigest`
- `evidenceOnly`

## Example scenario

| Input | Expected result |
|---|---|
| `source.observation.v1` for `repo:adrs` observed on GitHub | validates in source lane |
| `source.observation.v1` for `package:ceo` observed in `repo:adrs` | validates in source lane |
| source receipt generation | emits deterministic `source.receipt.v1` |
| authority-bearing source observation | rejected |
| same source row sent to hq model queue | rejected outside this package |

## Acceptance criteria

- New source evidence package is registered in `build/packages.jsonl`.
- New checks are registered in `build/checks.jsonl`.
- `source.observation.v1` positive fixture validates.
- `source.receipt.v1` positive fixture validates.
- Source receipt digest is deterministic.
- Source observation with `accepted`, `admitted`, `ledgerAuthority`, `writesAcceptedLedger`, or equivalent authority-bearing fields is rejected.
- Source observation can represent at least:
  - GitHub repo observed.
  - package/path observed in repo.
  - package/path missing in repo.
- No source observation is admitted into hq model accepted rows.
- No source runtime code imports editor UX, browser renderer, or hq model queue admission code except through fixtures/ports.

## Non-goals

- Do not change hq model queue kind set.
- Do not implement model/source reconciliation here.
- Do not claim production governance authority.
- Do not require live GitHub access in pure tests.

## Purpose lineage

| Generation | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Scope | Add a separate source observation and receipt lane |
| Repo split | Keep model queue in hq runtime and source evidence in its own package |
| Meta | Preserve model/data separation with deterministic evidence |
| Meta^10 | Make real-world observation auditable and transferable for sale-ready proof |"}

{"body":"## Purpose

Complete the repository-admin half of public URL acceptance after PR #292 merges.

## Required branch rule

Target branch: `proposals`

Required status check:

```text
Mobile Agent public URL required / gate
```

Required behavior:

- require a pull request before merge for Mobile Agent product/Carrier/deploy paths;
- require the check above to pass on the exact PR head;
- dismiss stale approvals/checks after the head changes;
- do not allow a bypass that reports or accepts a URL without `accepted/mobile-agent-public-url`;
- do not require this check for unrelated paths if GitHub rulesets with path targeting are available.

## Acceptance model

```text
public deploy proof
→ stable + immutable byte readback
→ stable + immutable real-Chrome proof
→ canonical PASS receipt
→ accepted/mobile-agent-public-url
→ exact-head required check
```

`proposals` is currently unprotected. Until this rule is enabled, `accepted/mobile-agent-public-url` remains the only reportable URL receipt source, but merge-level enforcement is not complete.

Refs #292 #233 #242 #279 #286."}

{"body":"## Purpose

Complete the repository-admin half of public URL acceptance after PR #292 merges.

## Required branch rule

Target branch: `proposals`

Required status check:

```text
Mobile Agent public URL required / gate
```

Required behavior:

- require a pull request before merge for Mobile Agent product/Carrier/deploy paths;
- require the check above to pass on the exact PR head;
- dismiss stale approvals/checks after the head changes;
- do not allow a bypass that reports or accepts a URL without `accepted/mobile-agent-public-url`;
- do not require this check for unrelated paths if GitHub rulesets with path targeting are available.

## Acceptance model

```text
public deploy proof
→ stable + immutable byte readback
→ stable + immutable real-Chrome proof
→ canonical PASS receipt
→ accepted/mobile-agent-public-url
→ exact-head required check
```

`proposals` is currently unprotected. Until this rule is enabled, `accepted/mobile-agent-public-url` remains the only reportable URL receipt source, but merge-level enforcement is not complete.

Refs #292 #233 #242 #279 #286."}

{"body":"## 現在の採用・host（2026-10-07）

[固定Rの最終独立判定](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/69#issuecomment-6023937891)は、reviewed head `99fbcda957ac96c171c0a0cc9245c286deb6e8e3` に対してGREEN・first-slice技術残件0。Humanの「okならmerge, then host here」に従い [apps#69](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/69)を2026-10-06T19:34:18Zに実mergeした。

- adopted commit: [`2022a8da358979b6360ef06795856b91b157185b`](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/commit/2022a8da358979b6360ef06795856b91b157185b)
- actual tree: `5659a07b209ccd172ad85ad58bd9f4ae3c76b165`。reviewed treeとの差分は先行voice-ui変更のみで、Atlasの7 pathsは同一。
- [採用後のCI](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/actions/runs/37519971555/job/112462571924)もcompleted/success。actual checkoutはadopted commit、Atlas **112/112 PASS**、既存flake check **all checks passed!**。x86_64-linux、aarch64は未実行。
- [このPCのhost](http://127.0.0.1:18186/atlas-closure-2022a8d/index.html)：初期JSONL、後着上流、後着nextの3結果と各actual CLI receiptを、採用commitのCLIで再生成。既存localhost hostを共有し、新serverは追加していない。
- HTTPの3結果は200で、各実生成物のbytes/hashと一致。初期4,019 bytes、後着上流4,434 bytes、後着next4,150 bytes。

完成範囲はデータ契約・CLI・独立review・採用・生成結果のlocalhost掲載。Atlas画面接続、#66移行、real source/OCI収集、Issue closeは未実施。生成fixtureはsynthetic/authority=false。ブラウザ操作は応答せず、目視確認はUNPROVEN、Codexの表示要求はqueuedとして保持する。

---

## Purpose

Atlasに、現在見えている活動だけでなく、**どこへ向かっているか / 何が足りないか / 何を閉じれば目的へ近づくか**を復活させる。

ui側のexample設計はこのIssueのscope外。まずapps側のAtlas application意味を閉じる。

Related:
- #66 — Atlas application ownership / bootstrap migration
- roccho-dev/ui#322 — extraction sequence
- roccho-dev/ui#332 — SharedAtlasUI capability proof
- legacy Purpose Atlas evidence: roccho-dev/ui `tests/fixtures/purpose-atlas/atlas-data.json` / expectation ledger

---

## Restore these meanings

| Meaning | Legacy Atlas | Current Atlas | Target |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Purpose / highest objective | ◎ | purpose target名だけ | ◎ |
| Ideal | ◎ | なし | ◎ |
| Current | ◎ | 現況はあるがPurposeと未接続 | ◎ |
| Gap | ◎ | なし | ◎ |
| Fill / Work order | ◎ | workはあるがgap closure意味なし | ◎ |
| Receipt | ◎ | evidence kindのみ | ◎ |
| Residual | ◎ | statusのみ | ◎ |
| Purpose closure path | ◎ | なし | ◎ |

Target meaning:

```text
Purpose
   ↑
Ideal
   ↑
Gap
 ↗   ↖
Current  Fill / Work
           ↓
        Receipt
           ↓
        Residual
           ↓
      next input / next gap
```

---

## Why two JSONL inputs

原初の意思決定だけに、後から生まれる全ての支流・上流・実行結果が含まれるとは限らない。

そのためAtlas applicationは、少なくとも2つの独立した投影入力をjoinする。

```text
purpose.jsonl
  purpose / ideal / accepted intent / closure expectation
       │
       │
       ├──────┐
       │      │
current.jsonl │
  observed current / work / evidence / receipt / residual
       │      │
       └──┬───┘
          ↓
      reduce/join
          ↓
atlas.reduced.jsonl
```

### Important

2 JSONLは2つのauthorityを作るためではない。

- source authorityは各owning domain/repoに残る
- `purpose.jsonl` と `current.jsonl` はAtlas向けprojection/input
- apps Atlasがjoin/reduceする
- **`atlas.reduced.jsonl` がAtlas consumer contract**
- reducedはprojection contractであり、business authorityではない

目的系・現況系の各JSONLの内部が、さらに複数sourceをreduceした結果であってよい。Atlasは「原初decision 1個ですべてを説明できる」ことを要求しない。

---

## Reduced contract

最低限、reduced outputで次の関係を失わない。

```text
purpose
ideal
current
gap
fill
receipt
residual
relation
sourceRef
sourceDigest
```

概念的なclosure:

```text
Current
  -> Gap
  -> Ideal
  -> Purpose

Gap
  -> Fill / Work
  -> Receipt
  -> Residual
  -> next Current or next Gap
```

### Invariants

- Purposeは単なるlabel targetに縮退しない
- Gapは色/statusではなく `current -> ideal` の差として表す
- Workは「実行中だから存在」ではなく、どのGapを閉じるかを結べる
- Receiptは証拠kindだけでなく、どのFillの結果かを結べる
- Residualはstatusだけでなく、Receipt後に何が残ったかを結べる
- Residualから次のinput / next gapへ再帰できる
- source provenanceを保持し、reducedから元sourceへ辿れる
- UIやappsがbusiness authorityをmintしない

---

## Recursive closure

この設計では、目的到達を1回で閉じる必要はない。

```text
Purpose
  ↑
Gap A
  ↑
Fill A
  ↓
Receipt A
  ↓
Residual A
  ↓
Gap B
  ↑
Fill B
  ↓
...
```

**Residualが次のcontract/inputになれること**を前提にする。

これにより、支流・上流が増えてもAtlasのメンタルモデルを増やさず、同じclosure形を再帰利用できる。

---

## Ownership

### apps owns

- purpose/current projection inputsのjoin
- Atlas用reduced contract
- Purpose Closure application semantics
- gap / fill / receipt / residual のapplication-level relation
- application source/adaptation/bootstrap

### ui owns

- SharedAtlasUI
- generic read-model / projection / camera / renderer
- application意味を知らない表示能力

### domain owners own

- purpose / decision authority
- observed runtime/business state authority
- receipts / evidence authority

---

## First implementation slice

最初は旧Atlasの意味を小さく復活する。

1. `purpose.jsonl`
2. `current.jsonl`
3. deterministic join/reducer
4. `atlas.reduced.jsonl`
5. Purpose / Ideal / Current / Gap / Fill / Receipt / Residual / closure path のcontract test

renderer変更やUI example変更はこのsliceに含めない。

---

## Acceptance

- [ ] Purpose / highest objective がreduced contractに存在
- [ ] Ideal と Current が別意味で存在
- [ ] Gap = Current と Ideal の差として辿れる
- [ ] Fill / Work が閉じるGapを参照
- [ ] Receipt がFillを参照
- [ ] Residual がReceiptを参照
- [ ] Residualからnext input / next gapへ再帰可能
- [ ] Purposeまでclosure pathを辿れる
- [ ] purpose/current双方のsource provenanceを保持
- [ ] same inputs -> same reduced bytes
- [ ] missing/conflicting relationはfail closed
- [ ] apps/uiがauthorityをmintしない
- [ ] ui exampleの形はこのIssueで固定しない

---

## Non-scope

- ui/examplesの追加・変更
- renderer / layout / Voronoi / actor-ringの復活
- Attention / ranking / Proposal
- real OCI discovery
- auto ticket creation
- new generic workflow/event-sourcing framework
- Purpose sourceを1個の原初decisionへ限定すること

> **Atlasは「今」を描くだけでなく、今が何を閉じ、どこへ向かうかをreduced contractとして読む。**"}

request.text:
{"body":"## Purpose

Produce UI-readable repo-map projection artifacts from ops-owned modeling runtime output.

## Scope

- Convert local shadow model state into `repoMap.projection.v1` or compatible projection JSON.
- Include projection digest and source queue/receipt references.
- Keep projection as generated artifact, not authority.
- Ensure output can be consumed by ui external input flow.

## Done

- model commit queue fixture produces a projection artifact.
- projection contains enough repo/package/model/relation data for ui preview.
- projection digest is stable for stable input.
- receipt references the projection digest.

## Scope-achievement declaration

This issue is complete only when all of the following are true:

- Purpose lineage: directly completes queue-to-ui handoff by producing the projection ui reads.
- Core/port/adapter: projection builder core is pure `model state -> repoMap projection`; projection output/input contracts are ports; file artifact writing is adapter.
- Pure/effect split: projection construction and digesting are pure; reading state/writing artifacts are adapter-only.
- False-positive exclusion: valid model states and queue-derived states must produce accepted projection fixtures.
- False-negative exclusion: malformed model states, authority-bearing projection claims, unstable digests, or ui-incompatible projection shapes must fail.
- Authority boundary: projection is generated read-model evidence only; accepted authority remains ledger after admission.
- Repo cleanliness: ops produces projection data only; it does not render HTML or own browser behavior.

## Non-goals

- Do not render HTML.
- Do not write accepted ledger.
- Do not own UI renderer behavior.

## Checks

- Projection fixture digest check.
- projection -> ui-compatible schema check.
- valid/invalid projection fixtures.
- Existing ops checks pass.

## Depends on

- #41
- #42

## Why this matters

This is the handoff point from ops runtime to ui read-only visualization."}

{"body":"## Purpose

Define the missing HQ local serve decision before adding more runtime implementation.

This issue fixes where HQ is served, where local runtime data lives, and what HQ is allowed to persist.

## Scope

- Define `hq serve local` as local-only execution.
- Define `$HQ_LOCAL_ROOT` as the local runtime root.
- Define local WIP persistence as recoverable local evidence, not authority.
- Define authority persistence as outside HQ local runtime.
- Define that remote bare repo remains the canonical SSOT for accepted records.
- Define that GitHub issues/comments remain discussion, append/readback, CI, and review surfaces, not authority.
- Define that ChatGPT interacts through GitHub issue/comment/PR surfaces, not direct local HQ control.

## Required path catalog

The issue must define a path catalog equivalent to:

```text
$HQ_LOCAL_ROOT/
  queues/
    hq.model-commit.queue.jsonl
    hq.agent-task.queue.jsonl
  state/
    shadow-model.v1.jsonl
    agent-task-state.v1.jsonl
  proposals/
    modeling.proposal.v1.jsonl
  ledgers/
    staged.accepted.model-commit.v1.jsonl
  projections/
    repoMap.projection.v1.json
    repoMap.projection.v1.jsonl
  receipts/
    hq.receipt.v1.jsonl
    admission.receipt.v1.jsonl
    cross-repo.editor-to-ui.receipt.v1.jsonl
  previews/
    repo-map/
      index.html
      manifest.json
  cache/
    github-readback/
    ssot-mirror/
```

Names may be refined by implementation, but the separation must remain.

## Done

- `hq serve local` is explicitly local-only.
- API exposure is limited to local loopback or unix socket; no remote HQ server is introduced.
- `$HQ_LOCAL_ROOT` path catalog is documented.
- queue, state, proposal, staged ledger, projection, receipt, preview, and cache responsibilities are separated.
- local WIP persistence is allowed only for recovery and proof.
- authority persistence is explicitly out of local HQ and belongs to accepted SSOT promotion.
- Existing `ops#38-51`, `edits#49-55`, and `ui#127-134` are linked as downstream users of this boundary.

## Scope-achievement declaration

This issue is complete only when all of the following are true:

- Purpose lineage: directly supports editor-to-queue-to-ui by defining the local runtime place; directly supports clean repo ownership; indirectly supports sale-ready explainability.
- Core/port/adapter: local root layout is a port contract; serve process and file IO are adapters; no domain meaning is stored only in adapter code.
- Pure/effect split: path resolution and record classification are pure; serving, reading, writing, and cleanup are side-effect adapters.
- False-positive exclusion: valid local WIP evidence under the approved path catalog must not be rejected as authority leakage.
- False-negative exclusion: queue/state/projection/preview/receipt files outside the approved root, or any claim that local HQ is authority, must fail.
- Authority boundary: HQ local persistence is never canonical authority.
- Repo cleanliness: HQ local runtime paths must not be committed into repos as source, except fixtures and docs.

## Non-goals

- Do not implement the server in this issue.
- Do not run a real agent.
- Do not promote anything to remote bare repo.
- Do not open new ADRS issue; link to `adrs#202` by comment only.

## Checks

- Path catalog doc/static check.
- Authority prohibition wording check.
- Repo pollution guard for `$HQ_LOCAL_ROOT` outputs.

## Related

- adrs#202 architecture hub.
- adrs#185 provider-independent work ledger boundary.
- adrs#190 remote/ref projection boundary.
- adrs#198 JSONL comment readback proof.
- ops#38-51 existing queue/runtime/proof issues.
- edits#49-55 existing editor/queue-writer issues.
- ui#127-134 existing targetRef/projection/preview issues."}

{"body":"# Canonical N-way semantic-conflict attempt plan — r4

このIssueを、`ops#267`を起源とする**意図的な意味競合検知attempt**の現行正本とする。

- r3 (`nway-semantic-fefd986e-a3`) は `CURRENT_ATTEMPT_ENDED / PIPELINE_ERROR` で終了済み
- r3のcandidate、branch-set、Receipt、workflow runは履歴として不変
- r3のcandidate/ref/receiptをr4へ再利用しない
- 新しいユーザー意思決定は「同一surfaceのprovides / requiresを意図的に不一致にし、既存Gateが競合を検知してBLOCKすることを確認する」

成果物の正本はGitHubからfresh Readbackしたcommit、tree、blob、ref、workflow factsとする。

## Policy / ownership

Runbook `shiftleft-admission/nway` に従う。

- `user`: 目的、開始、role assignment、新しい意思決定
- `c.p.merge`: Issue plan、closed work set、roleごとのbranch / 許可path / Evidence固定、監視、branch-set、Gate request、closure
- `c.p.work1..N`: 自分に宣言されたcandidateだけ
- `c.e`: PASS時のexact Git effectだけ

今回、userが競合検知を目的としてwork1..3の再分担開始を決定し、`c.p.merge`が以下の具体的分担を固定する。

## Objective / YAGNI boundary

既存のbounded N-way workflow、`shiftleft-nway-branch-set/2`、`json-pointer` Provider、`require-provide` Gate、Readbackだけを使う。

- 新しいworkflow、Provider、Gate、比較器、dependency、PRを作らない
- product behavior、default branch、既存product fileを変更しない
- 各workは新規proof fileを1つだけ追加する
- 競合検知時は`BLOCK`で終了し、resultへのGit effectを行わない
- r3のS6問題は本attemptの修正対象にしない。r4はS5で停止することを期待する

## Revision / attempt identity

- repository: `roccho-dev/ops`
- origin plan: `ops#267`
- previous revision: `nway-semantic-fefd986e-r3`
- plan revision: `nway-semantic-conflict-fefd986e-r4`
- attempt_id: `nway-semantic-conflict-fefd986e-a4`
- coordinator / monitor / integrator: `c.p.merge`
- branch-set schema: `shiftleft-nway-branch-set/2`
- branch-set setId: `github-proof.fefd986e.semantic-conflict-r4`
- required work set: exactly `{work1, work2, work3}`

## Existing bounded workflow boundary

- Gate request Issue: `ops#231`
- request schema: `ops.nwayGithubAdmissionRequest/1`
- fixed branch-set ref: `refs/heads/proof-nway-github-6a85fd4d-branch-set`
- branch-set expected-old commit: `b3bacee662fde1d13d72951d9c15d6971f0cd134`
- branch-set expected-old tree: `2fe7eb4b6c251b399c6cb526756133f69ad911ec`
- new branch-set commit parent: exactly the expected-old commit above
- result ref: `refs/heads/proof-nway-github-6a85fd4d-result-semantic-r4-conflict`
- candidate prefix: `refs/heads/proof/nway-semantic-fefd986e-r4/`

Issue更新直前のGitHub Readbackでは、fixed branch-set refはexpected-old commitに一致し、r4 candidate prefixとr4 result refは`ABSENT`だった。

expected-oldがfan-in前またはCAS直前に動いた場合、本attemptは停止する。force updateしない。

## Exact candidate base

- commit: `fefd986e460756b17cc03231c0c7d3274bb48e26`
- tree: `e5f3c455f43b81acb100f6e0229777fe4cae707c`
- source workflow run: `32455591909`
- source artifact: `9437150252`
- source artifact SHA-256: `fd3728735498d3cad41dfb554277e0c0606b4ae3f7b5be45e996403e975956ee`

全candidateはこのexact baseの直接の子1 commitとする。

## Closed work assignment

| role | memberId | candidate ref | allowed path | exact commit message | meaning role |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `c.p.work1` | `provider` | `refs/heads/proof/nway-semantic-fefd986e-r4/provider` | `verification/nway-semantic-fefd986e-r4/provider.json` | `proof(nway): provide conflicting shared value semantic r4` | `shared.value/default`をprovides |
| `c.p.work2` | `consumer` | `refs/heads/proof/nway-semantic-fefd986e-r4/consumer` | `verification/nway-semantic-fefd986e-r4/consumer.json` | `proof(nway): require conflicting shared value semantic r4` | 同じ`shared.value/default`をrequires |
| `c.p.work3` | `independent` | `refs/heads/proof/nway-semantic-fefd986e-r4/independent` | `verification/nway-semantic-fefd986e-r4/independent.txt` | `proof(nway): independent member semantic r4` | surface非参加のrequired member |

### Exact file bytes

`provider.json` — final LFあり:

```json
{"value":"semantic-r4-fefd986e-provided"}
```

`consumer.json` — final LFあり:

```json
{"expected":"semantic-r4-fefd986e-required"}
```

`independent.txt` — final LFあり:

```text
independent=semantic-r4-fefd986e
```

`provided`と`required`は両方JSON stringだが、文字列値は意図的に不一致である。

    {
      "id": "consumer",
      "ref": "refs/heads/proof/nway-semantic-fefd986e-r4/consumer",
      "candidateCommit": "<authoritative readback OID>",
      "candidateTree": "<authoritative readback OID>",
      "required": true,
      "intent": "consumer candidate",
      "declaredScopes": ["verification/nway-semantic-fefd986e-r4/consumer.json"]
    },
    {
      "id": "independent",
      "ref": "refs/heads/proof/nway-semantic-fefd986e-r4/independent",
      "candidateCommit": "<authoritative readback OID>",
      "candidateTree": "<authoritative readback OID>",
      "required": true,
      "intent": "independent candidate",
      "declaredScopes": ["verification/nway-semantic-fefd986e-r4/independent.txt"]
    }
  ],
  "surfaces": [
    {
      "id": "shared.value",
      "variant": "default",
      "rule": "require-provide",
      "probes": [
        {
          "id": "provided",
          "memberId": "provider",
          "direction": "provides",
          "provider": "json-pointer",

{"body":"## Purpose

Close the model/source-data boundary hole in `hq-modeling-runtime`.

Current behavior is directionally correct: direct `source.observation.v1` rows are rejected because the hq model queue accepts only `hq.modelCommitQueued.v1`, `hq.agentTaskQueued.v1`, and `hq.receipt.v1`.

However, source-data-shaped records can still be smuggled inside `hq.modelCommitQueued.v1.payload`, because the payload validator currently only requires an object. That weakens the model/data split needed for buyer-auditable, receipt-backed reconstruction.

## Solved state

| Area | Solved state |
|---|---|
| model queue | accepts model intent only |
| direct source data | direct `source.*` rows remain rejected by the model queue |
| payload smuggling | embedded `source.*`, `source.observation.v1`, `source.receipt.v1`, `model_source_reconcile.v1`, `admission.*`, or accepted-ledger-shaped rows are rejected recursively |
| agent task | source-check work can still be represented as `hq.agentTaskQueued.v1` pending intent, not accepted model data |
| receipts | hq receipts remain evidence-only |
| projections | hq model projection remains generated read model, not authority |
| admission | admits only clean `hq.modelCommitQueued.v1` rows |

## Fix policy

- Do not add `source.observation.v1` to the hq model queue kind set.
- Do not turn source data into model queue input.
- Keep source observation and model/source reconciliation in separate lanes.
- Keep this fix limited to preventing model queue contamination.
- Keep pure validation in core and file/process effects outside core.

## Fix targets

| Target | Required change |
|---|---|
| `packages/hq-modeling-runtime/lib/queue-schema.mjs` | define forbidden embedded row kinds / namespaces for model payloads |
| `packages/hq-modeling-runtime/lib/queue-validator.mjs` | recursively reject forbidden embedded source/reconcile/receipt/admission/accepted-shaped records inside model payload |
| `packages/hq-modeling-runtime/tests/queue-validator.mjs` | add negative fixtures for source observation payload smuggling |
| `packages/hq-modeling-runtime/tests/admission-gate.mjs` | prove smuggled source data cannot be admitted |
| `packages/hq-modeling-runtime/tests/projection-builder.mjs` | prove smuggled source data does not create projection nodes/edges |
| `packages/hq-modeling-runtime/README.md` | document that model queue is model-intent only and source data belongs to a separate lane |
| `docs/editor-queue-ui-ops-boundary.md` | document the model / source / reconcile split |
| `build/checks.jsonl` | register any new boundary check if added |

## Acceptance criteria

- Existing hq modeling runtime checks still pass.
- Model rows such as `actor:codex -> role:ceo`, `role:ceo -> package:ceo`, and `package:ceo -> repo:adrs` still validate, process, receipt, project, and local-dev admit.
- Direct `source.observation.v1` rows still fail in the hq model queue with `unknown-kind` or equivalent.
- `source.observation.v1` wrapped inside `hq.modelCommitQueued.v1.payload` is rejected.
- `source.receipt.v1` wrapped inside model payload is rejected.
- `model_source_reconcile.v1` wrapped inside model payload is rejected.
- Accepted/admission/ledger-authority-shaped records wrapped inside model payload are rejected.
- `hq.agentTaskQueued.v1` remains available for source-check work as pending intent only.
- Admission emits no accepted-ledger-shaped row for source/reconcile/evidence data.

## Non-goals

- Do not implement source observation validation here.
- Do not implement model/source reconciliation here.
- Do not change production governance authority.
- Do not move CUE contract core into hq runtime.

## Purpose lineage

| Generation | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Scope | Prevent source data from entering model queue through payload smuggling |
| Repo split | Keep hq modeling runtime model-only while source evidence and reconcile remain separate lanes |
| Meta | Preserve model/data separation with mechanical false-negative protection |
| Meta^10 | Improve auditability and transferability for sale-ready operational proof |"}

{"body":"<!-- voice-ui-artifact-chain-20260929-v1 step0 carrier-A -->
## Purpose

Step A of the voice-ui artifact chain under roccho-dev/adrs#453. Today apps builds `hayamimi-web` from a pinned ops source revision. This Issue makes ops publish `hayamimi-web` as an exact, verifiable artifact, so apps can consume bytes instead of ops source.

Governing control version: `voice-ui-artifact-chain-20260929-v1`, applied at roccho-dev/adrs PR 456 commit `66d4432b92e5526f532b4a935aef4d77775ef766`. GO: https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/pull/456#issuecomment-5884687101

## Scope

Harden only the existing `.github/workflows/hayamimi-web-release.yml`:

- Guard: publish only when the repository `default_branch` and the ref are both `proposals`.
- Pin every `uses:` in the changed workflow to a 40-hex commit.
- In the same run, at the exact merged SHA: build, `nix flake check`, verify and package.
- Tag with the full SHA.
- Publish the zip sha256 plus a provenance record: {producer, workflow, exact source, `flake.lock` and source-lock digests, bytes digest, locator, `cross_host_bytes_reproducible: false`}.
- Publish a merged-PR proof JSON, generated from the GitHub API (never hand-copied): {pr_number, r_exact_head_verdict_ref, merged_at, base: proposals, reviewed_head, reviewed_tree, merge_sha, merge_tree}.
- Re-download the published assets and compare them byte for byte.
- The `contents:write` job runs no Nix.

## Acceptance evidence

- The PR records exact base, head, tree, changed files and required checks, read back from GitHub.
- A workflow lint fails on any Nix invocation in any `contents:write` job.
- The workflow publishes only from an exact merged `proposals` PR, compares re-downloaded bytes, and uploads only an exact asset allowlist.

## Non-goals

- Publishing a release, pushing a tag or running `workflow_dispatch`. These need separate User authorization.
- Any Cloudflare, provider-projection or envs work.
- Changing apps, or the ops deployer (roccho-dev/ops#435 and roccho-dev/ops#436 own that).
- A new generic publisher framework.

## Relations

- Mapping owner: roccho-dev/adrs#453.
- Downstream consumer: the apps sub-issue of roccho-dev/apps#26 for provider-artifact consumption (step B2).
"}

request.text:
{"body":"## Parent and dependencies

- Integration tracker: roccho-dev/adrs#318
- Semantic producer: roccho-dev/governance#204
- Read-only consumer: roccho-dev/ui#168
- Reuse `gosh` as the thin execution/evidence layer; do not move ADR meaning into `gosh`.

## Goal

Compose the ADR decision pipeline from exact single binaries, publish verified immutable decision projections, update a small current manifest only after successful readback, and prove the deployed authenticated UI from its human type/status routes.

```text
gosh
  -> github-adrs-fetch
  -> decisionctl
  -> decision-publish
       -> immutable upload
       -> immutable readback + digest verification
       -> current manifest update
       -> current manifest readback
       -> authenticated browser verification
```

This issue owns execution, provider binding, publication ordering, current-pointer effects, and remote evidence. It does not own ADR lifecycle semantics or UI rendering semantics.

## Minimal runtime

Expected steady-state shape:

```text
gosh + GitHub adapter bin + decisionctl + publication bin
```

Managed authentication and object/static storage remain platform services, not local process-manager responsibilities.

`gosh` owns only:

- exact executable resolution
- direct argv invocation without shell-string composition
- ordered execution and failure propagation
- exact input/output/binary digests
- append-only execution/result evidence

`gosh` must not decide authority, lifecycle state, renderer selection, or current decision meaning.

## Publication contract

Immutable artifacts are published before mutable discovery state.

Required order:

```text
1. produce and verify local artifact set
2. upload digest-addressed immutable assets
3. read every immutable asset back from the provider
4. verify bytes, digest, content type, and expected metadata
5. construct current manifest referencing only verified assets
6. update current manifest atomically or with provider-appropriate compare-and-swap protection
7. read current manifest back
8. resolve the human route through the deployed UI
9. authenticate and verify the browser-visible semantic snapshot
```

A failed step before current update leaves current unchanged. A failed current update or readback is a failed run and must not be reported as published.

## Proposed artifact layout

The physical layout may vary by provider, but the following semantics are required:

```text
/data/<projection-digest>/<decision_type>/<status>.jsonl
/data/<projection-digest>/routes.logical.json
/data/<projection-digest>/publication.json
/current/manifest.json
```

`current/manifest.json` is a replaceable discovery pointer, not decision authority. Immutable artifact bytes must never be overwritten in place.

## Current manifest requirements

At minimum:

```json
{
  "contract": "adr-decision-publication/1",
  "projection_digest": "sha256:...",
  "logical_routes_digest": "sha256:...",
  "published_at": "provider receipt value",
  "routes": [
    {
      "logical_route": "decisions/architecture/accepted",
      "asset_url": "/data/sha256-.../architecture/accepted.jsonl",
      "asset_digest": "sha256:...",
      "renderer_id": "decision-list/1"
    }
  ]
}
```

body内の各文を、望ましい状態の宣言と、実際に起きたことの報告に分けて読んでください。EとOは同時にyesでも構いません。Eは文書の主題や多数決ではなく存在判定です。具体的な要求文・完成条件・目標文が一文でもあれば、残りが全部作業報告でもE=yesです。例えば「利用者に完了を通知すること」は期待ですが、「利用者に通知した」は実施報告であり期待ではありません。Goal・Acceptanceという見出しそのものは期待文ではなく、その下に過去の実施報告しかなければE=noです。表・数式・役割が完成状態の対応を定義する場合も期待です。Oでは実測の引用・確認状況一覧・本文内HTMLコメントの作業メモも数えますが、架空の試験入力・条件付きの例は数えません。許容を表す「〜でもよい」や仮定・可能性だけを述べる文は、現状の報告ではありません。例えば「点検は後日でもよい」は許容条件ですが、「点検はまだしていない」は現在の状態の報告です。O=yesにするには、本文が現実にそうだと主張している箇所が必要です。与えられたbody全体だけを対象に判断し、そこにない現状を推測しないでください。
本問はOだけ：本文が実際の出来事や達成状況を報告しているか。現在形の定義、完成状態の表、役割、将来条件や架空の入力例は報告ではない。実測の引用、確認済み/未確認の進捗一覧、HTMLコメント内の作業メモは報告に含める。comments配列内だけの観測は数えない。
